invariant.statement: A staking/reserve protocol’s claimed backing must be independently recomputable from chain state at the pinned slot, cover its liability, and carry no stale records.

verdict.reason: Recomputed backing covers liability; redeemable backing proven on-chain; no stale records.

reproduce.level1_offline: node verify.mjs <claim.json>              # re-derive the verdict from the recomputed quantities (offline)
reproduce.level2_onchain: node ../redde/verify-marinade.mjs --json  # re-compute the quantities from mainnet at the pinned slot
